feature: Opt-in hand snap kinematic prototype and local sparks
review: One detector update per XR frame; both eyes share same event/geometry
Valid tracked finite joints; temporal contact/release with distal confirmation
Reset preparation on loss, gap, origin change or time discontinuity; cooldown survives tracking loss
At most one active burst per hand; finite bounded mesh and 450 ms expiry
No camera/scene displacement applied to physical particles
Additive depth-tested particles share existing HDR and final fade
P1 tests use temporary reference dose instead of modifying user configuration
git diff --check and new-file whitespace check passed
limitations: No physical Quest snap validation yet
Kinematic approximation, no microphone or confirmation of audible snap
